claim_ceiling: Fault-injection specification only. No systemd VM execution, host power-loss guarantee, durable-journal qualification, or privileged worker qualification is claimed by this corpus.
prerequisites: Exact Nixward commit, Cargo.lock, flake.lock, Nixpkgs revision, kernel and systemd version recorded
NixOS-declared test-only static worker template with a fixed store-path executable
Harmless worker that does not perform NixOS activation or mutate host configuration
Mock participant with its own test-only effect ledger and idempotency behavior
Nixward existing transaction journal/interlock is the only Nixward transaction authority

cuts.inject: Kill the supervisor before the existing Nixward journal accepts the attempt-intent append.
cuts.durable_prefix: No attempt-intent or submission-barrier record exists.
cuts.manager_state: No StartUnit call is permitted by the program-order contract; verify with an instrumented D-Bus fake.
cuts.allowed_action: Return to authorization/preflight; create no worker until a new durable attempt intent is published.
required_evidence: journal scan proves no attempt record
cuts.safety_invariant: No manager start and no participant effect can precede the durable attempt-intent barrier.

cuts.inject: Kill Nixward after the journal confirms durable intent/barrier publication but before system-bus connection.
cuts.durable_prefix: Attempt ID, transaction ID, purpose, canonical unit identity and write-ahead barrier are durable.
cuts.manager_state: No call is issued in the injected test; after restart, an absent unit is not authoritative proof that no invocation occurred.
cuts.allowed_action: Read-only journal and manager reconciliation; require authoritative attempt-specific no-start proof before a fresh attempt.
cuts.safety_invariant: A durable barrier commits the system to reconciliation; missing unit state is not a no-effect proof.

cuts.inject: Crash after JobRemoved match and Manager.Subscribe succeed but before StartUnit is invoked.
cuts.durable_prefix: Attempt intent/barrier exists; no direct manager reply is persisted.
cuts.manager_state: A process-local signal subscription is lost on crash; post-restart manager state may be absent or unknown.
cuts.allowed_action: Reconcile the exact attempt; do not resubmit the same attempt from recovered in-memory assumptions.
cuts.safety_invariant: Subscription success is not start acknowledgement or proof of non-execution.

cuts.inject: Drop the D-Bus method reply after systemd has enqueued the canonical attempt unit, then kill the supervisor.
cuts.durable_prefix: Write-ahead barrier exists; direct returned job object path is absent from the journal.
cuts.manager_state: Systemd may have a queued/running/completed job; JobRemoved may already have been emitted.
cuts.allowed_action: Query canonical unit and reconcile available job, InvocationID and process evidence; never replay the attempt.
cuts.safety_invariant: Lost StartUnit response never authorizes a second StartUnit call.

cuts.inject: Kill supervisor after exact StartUnit object path is durably recorded but before JobRemoved observation.
cuts.durable_prefix: Attempt intent, barrier and exact direct job object path are durable.
cuts.manager_state: The matching job may still be running, queued or already terminal.
cuts.allowed_action: Resume read-only observation for the exact returned object path; no new manager start.
cuts.safety_invariant: An acknowledged start can only be observed/reconciled, never implicitly restarted.

cuts.inject: Deliver the matching JobRemoved event, then crash before the caller publishes the signal receipt.
cuts.durable_prefix: Direct StartUnit reply is durable; JobRemoved receipt is not.
cuts.manager_state: Job may already have been unloaded; absence after restart is inconclusive.
cuts.allowed_action: Query retained manager metadata and continue reconciliation; do not infer completion solely from unit absence.
cuts.safety_invariant: Observed-but-unpersisted signal data cannot advance the durable transaction state.

cuts.inject: Start harmless one-shot worker, then kill supervisor before InvocationID and process identity are durably bound to the attempt.
cuts.durable_prefix: Manager start reply/job evidence exists; worker identity receipt is absent.
cuts.manager_state: Unit may be activating/running/exited; invocation and PID may exist.
cuts.allowed_action: Reconcile systemd InvocationID, cgroup/process identity and journal; payload must remain unreleased without durable identity binding.
cuts.safety_invariant: No mutating payload is released before exact worker identity has been durably bound.

cuts.inject: Persist exact worker invocation/process identity, then kill the supervisor before the one-shot release capability is consumed.
cuts.durable_prefix: Attempt, manager reply and worker identity are durable; payload-release event is absent.
cuts.manager_state: Worker is present but must be blocked at the release gate.
cuts.allowed_action: Revalidate exact attempt, grant, plan, unit invocation and process identity before any same-attempt continuation.
cuts.safety_invariant: Worker existence is not permission to release a payload; release is a separate durably gated transition.

cuts.inject: Release harmless worker payload, then SIGKILL worker/supervisor at deterministic instruction/marker points while mock participant effect is in flight.
cuts.durable_prefix: Payload-release event is durable; terminal process/participant receipt may be absent.
cuts.manager_state: Unit can be failed, stopped or absent; external effect may or may not have committed.
cuts.allowed_action: Reconcile same attempt against participant ledger and independent postcondition; do not issue a duplicate effect.
cuts.safety_invariant: After payload release, effect ambiguity is resolved by participant evidence, not by retry.

cuts.inject: Allow harmless worker to exit, then kill supervisor before durable process-exit receipt publication.
cuts.durable_prefix: Payload-release event is durable; process receipt is absent.
cuts.manager_state: Unit may be inactive/unloaded; systemd exit metadata may or may not remain queryable.
cuts.allowed_action: Reconcile exact InvocationID, cgroup, exit status and participant effect; retain unknown if the receipt cannot be established.
cuts.safety_invariant: Missing process receipt cannot be replaced by an agent/tool success claim.

cuts.inject: Persist process receipt and exit status, then kill supervisor before observing running closure and selected profile.
cuts.durable_prefix: Process disposition receipt is durable; target postcondition evidence is absent.
cuts.manager_state: Worker unit is terminal; target state is not yet proved.
cuts.allowed_action: Perform fresh read-only running-closure and selected-profile observations; no mutation is needed to claim success.
cuts.safety_invariant: Process exit is not host-state success.

cuts.inject: Capture a positive fresh target observation, then kill supervisor before terminal-success journal commit.
cuts.durable_prefix: Process receipt and target-observation evidence exist; terminal commit is absent.
cuts.manager_state: Worker is terminal; target may drift after the observation.
cuts.allowed_action: Revalidate observation freshness and target identity, then commit only if all existing terminal gates still hold.
cuts.safety_invariant: A non-durable terminal claim is not terminal success; re-observe before commit.

cuts.inject: Restart or re-exec the test VM's systemd manager while a harmless transaction unit is queued/running; do not alter the Nixward journal.
cuts.durable_prefix: Nixward journal contains exact attempt and latest persisted manager/process receipts.
cuts.manager_state: Job signal stream is lost; unit/invocation/process state must be re-queried.
cuts.allowed_action: Reconcile journal with surviving unit/cgroup and process state; no duplicate unit or payload.
cuts.safety_invariant: Manager restart cannot erase uncertainty or reset the durable attempt identity.

cuts.inject: Abruptly terminate the disposable VM process after barrier publication, then boot from its captured virtual disk image.
cuts.durable_prefix: Whatever the guest filesystem actually persisted must be recovered from disk; host-side harness records poweroff boundary.
cuts.manager_state: All in-memory manager and process state is lost on boot.
cuts.allowed_action: Run full journal and participant reconciliation before any mutation; no automatic replay.
cuts.safety_invariant: A VM poweroff test only qualifies the exact hypervisor/storage configuration and does not prove physical-device power-loss semantics.

cuts.inject: Inject deterministic I/O errors at each journal publication stage using a disposable VM block device configured for the selected error model.
cuts.durable_prefix: For each cut, record whether temp bytes, renamed final file and directory entry survive restart; never infer durability from a successful write syscall alone.
cuts.manager_state: No StartUnit call may occur unless the exact write-ahead publication contract reports durable success.
cuts.allowed_action: Fail closed before manager mutation when durable publication cannot be confirmed; retain recoverable orphan temp artifacts for audit.
cuts.safety_invariant: A partial or non-durable write-ahead record never authorizes StartUnit.

controls.requirement: Normal harmless worker completes; durable process receipt and fresh runtime/profile observation are persisted; terminal claim matches all exact identities.
StartUnit reply is lost after enqueue; absent unit after reboot must not authorize a retry.
Duplicate StartUnit or payload-release request for the same attempt must be denied by mode=fail and the existing journal interlock.
Payload release with a mismatched transaction, attempt, unit, InvocationID, executable digest or authorization must be denied.
Missing or stale external target observation cannot be promoted to terminal success.

promotion_gates: No production activation payload in v1 VM campaign
Zero duplicate worker or participant effects in canonical faults
No manager start before durable write-ahead publication
No payload release before durable exact worker identity binding
No new attempt after ambiguity without authoritative no-effect proof and fresh authorization
No terminal success without durable process receipt and fresh target observation
Exact Nixpkgs, kernel, systemd, Nixward, VM and storage fault-model pins retained in every receipt
